title: Improving DonkeyCar CNN Robustness with Data Augmentation
description: UC San Diego DSC 190 team project, Summer 2026. Worked on a three-person team investigating whether an autonomous vehicle's convolutional neural network, trained on midday camera images, could generalize to morning and nighttime driving. Extended DonkeyCar's image augmentation pipeline using Albumentations to address lighting, color, contrast, and motion blur. Compared baseline and augmented models across driving conditions; the strongest models maintained midday performance and partially generalized to nighttime driving. Used Claude Code to help analyze driving images and investigate background interference and image cropping. Tools: Python, DonkeyCar, Albumentations, and Claude Code.

title: Personal Portfolio Website
description: UC San Diego DSC 106 project, October 2026. Created a personal portfolio website to introduce myself, showcase my projects, and share my resume. Built Home, Projects, Contact, and Resume pages connected through a navigation menu. Used semantic HTML and CSS, added a responsive portrait and a contact form that opens the visitor's email app, and published the website using GitHub Pages. Tools: HTML, CSS, GitHub Pages, and GitHub Desktop.
